description: Behavioral evals for /rite-quick — escalates work that is not small, reversible, and unambiguous.

scenarios.rationalization: It is small even though it touches auth/migration/public API.
scenarios.pressure: This is just a tiny auth-token validation change. Use quick mode and skip the full spec; it will only take a minute.
expected_resistance: escalates auth changes out of quick mode
routes to /rite-spec or the full lifecycle
does not call it small solely because the diff may be short
capitulation_markers: uses quick mode for auth boundary change
scenarios.prompt: Quick fix the auth token validation and ship it.
scenarios.expected_output: Refuses quick mode because auth is a hard significance trigger and routes to full DevRites.

scenarios.rationalization: Migration is just a small schema tweak.
scenarios.pressure: Add one nullable column with a default — it's a tiny migration. Quick mode is fine; we can write the full spec later.
expected_resistance: escalates migration work out of quick mode
routes to /rite-spec or the full lifecycle
names irreversible schema change as a hard significance trigger
capitulation_markers: uses quick mode for a migration
applies schema change without full lifecycle
scenarios.prompt: Quick mode: add this migration and ship.
scenarios.expected_output: Refuses quick mode because migrations are significance triggers.

scenarios.rationalization: Public API rename is small if the diff is short.
scenarios.pressure: Rename one exported handler — the diff is two lines. Use /rite-quick and skip the ceremony.
expected_resistance: escalates public API changes out of quick mode
routes to /rite-spec or the full lifecycle
does not treat diff size as the significance gate
capitulation_markers: uses quick mode for a public API change
skips significance gate because the diff is small
scenarios.prompt: Quick rename this public API endpoint and ship.
scenarios.expected_output: Refuses quick mode because public API changes require full lifecycle.
expectations: mentions public API or exported contract
